P304.succ.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space, $a \in \mathbb{N}$, and $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$ a kernel satisfying `KernelProofData a K`, and assume $X$ satisfies the cancellativity condition `IsCancellative X (defaultτ a)`. Let $q, q'$ be nonnegative reals, $F \subseteq X$, $f : X \to \mathbb{C}$ and $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$. Given data $P$ of type $\mathrm{P304}(q,q',F,f,\sigma_1,\sigma_2)$, `P304.succ P` is again data of type $\mathrm{P304}(q,q',F,f,\sigma_1,\sigma_2)$; according to its docstring, it constructs $G_{n+1}$ given $G_n$.
